title: Political Economics of Marxism and Leninism

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand core concepts of Marxist and Leninist political economics, including market dynamics, value theory, and surplus value.
Analyze and evaluate economic relationships and interests in the context of modern socio-economic development.
Develop independent learning habits and the ability to accumulate knowledge and experience to enhance professional competence.
Demonstrate social responsibility and global awareness in personal and professional contexts.
Grasp the fundamental theories of value labor, surplus value, and market dynamics as proposed by Marx and Lenin.
Understand Lenin's theories on monopoly and state monopoly in capitalist market economies.
Comprehend the characteristics and relationships of interests in a socialism-oriented market economy in Vietnam.
Analyze the process of industrialization, modernization, and economic integration in Vietnam.
Apply research methods and theories to analyze economic phenomena and relationships.
Utilize theoretical foundations to solve economic problems and conflicts of interest in practical scenarios.
